sources.note: Call 2027 (May 2026): target group, the seven master's courses with university, teaching language and duration
Information brochure on the seven master's courses (March 2026): content, specialisations, target groups, entry requirements

subject_rule: Limited: scholarships are only for the seven master's courses named in the call (public policy and good governance); applicants need a first degree in Social and Political Sciences, Law, Economics, or Public Policy and Administration.

programmes.name: Social Protection
programmes.detail: 4 semesters, English; blended learning (semester 1 at the university, semester 2 online, semester 3 practical term, semester 4 online for the thesis); target group: first degree in Economics/Business Administration, Politics, Law, Administration, Health, Education, Social Science, Psychology, International Relations/Development or related; at least 5 months professional experience

programmes.name: Development and Governance
programmes.detail: 2 semesters (one-year programme), English; political science sub-disciplines (development studies, international relations, peace and conflict studies, administration and policy studies, comparative politics); target group: first degree in Political Science, Social Science, Law or related (four-year bachelor's); at least 1 year professional experience

programmes.name: Public Policy
programmes.institution: Willy Brandt School of Public Policy, University of Erfurt
programmes.detail: 4 semesters (two-year), English; interdisciplinary; students specialise in two of five areas: Social Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management, Global Policy, Sustainable and Inclusive Development, Peace and Conflict, Digital Policy and Artificial Intelligence; mandatory internship; at least 1 year professional experience

programmes.name: Peace and Conflict Studies
programmes.detail: 4 semesters (two-year), English, Master of Arts; political science and sociology focus; students choose three of four specialisations (Regional/Global Orders, Sustainable Development, Global Justice, Media and Violence); mandatory internship; bachelor's with at least 30 ECTS in social science

programmes.name: Management in Nonprofit-Organisations
programmes.detail: 4 semesters (two-year), English; target group: bachelor's in Politics, Law, Economics or Administration; at least 2 years professional experience in the non-profit sector

programmes.name: Development Studies
programmes.detail: 4 semesters (two-year), English; target group: first degree in a social science (Economics, Anthropology, Demography, Human Geography, Sociology, Political Science, Administrative Science); 60 ECTS in social sciences and/or economics; applied module with research project or internship

programmes.name: Governance and Public Policy
programmes.detail: 4 semesters (two-year), bilingual programme that can be studied entirely in English; target group: first degree in a social science (Economics, Sociology, Political Science, Administrative Science or related); 60 ECTS in social sciences, economics and/or law; thesis module with research project or internship

notes: Seven master's courses recorded; the source states seven. Applicants may apply to at most two of them. All are English-taught (Governance and Public Policy at Passau is bilingual).
List year: call for studies starting September/October 2027, published May 2026; the brochure is dated March 2026.
not_stated: The announcement does not name a list of eligible first-degree majors beyond 'Social and Political Sciences, Law, Economics, Public Policy and Administration'; each course sets its own entry requirements.
